title: boedie_alfa_romeo_MiTo_honking_car_horn
author: boedie
changes: A real car horn going 'beep-beep… beep-beep-beep' (an Alfa Romeo MiTo honked in a forest car park; no taxi recording, so the closest genuine car-horn beeps). Trimmed to 2.75–5.40 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording.
